name: General prose (LinkedIn post) stacked with AI tells, fragment chains, and a tricolon habit
draft:
I've been thinking a lot about leadership lately.

It's not just about vision. It's about execution.

Great leaders delve into the details. They navigate the complexities. They embrace ambiguity.

This week I had a conversation that was a testament to the power of listening. A mentor, a colleague, a friend. Three perspectives, one lesson.

In today's fast-paced world, we are all on a journey. The landscape of work is ever-evolving. The path forward is unclear.

But here's the thing: leadership is a tapestry. Woven from small moments. Built on trust. Earned every day.

What's one lesson leadership taught you this year? Drop it in the comments.
